```{r}

get_season_celebrities <- function(season_num) {

  url <- paste0(
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/",
    "Dancing_with_the_Stars_(American_TV_series)_season_",
    season_num
  )

  page <- read_html(url)

  # Find the cast table
  tables <- page |> html_elements("table.wikitable")

  cast_table <- keep(tables, function(x) {
    headers <- x |> html_elements("th") |> html_text2()

    any(headers == "Celebrity") &&
      any(headers == "Notability")
  }) |> pluck(1)

  # Extract table data
  data <- cast_table |> html_table(fill = TRUE)

  # Extract celebrity Wikipedia links
  rows <- cast_table |> html_elements("tr")

  links <- map_chr(rows[-1], function(row) {

    link <- row |> html_element("a[href*='/wiki/']")

    if (inherits(link, "xml_missing")) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }

    url_absolute(
      html_attr(link, "href"),
      "https://en.wikipedia.org"
    )
  })

  tibble(
    season = season_num,
    celebrity = data[[1]],
    profession = data[[2]],
    wiki_url = links
  )
}

```


```{r}

season_1 <- get_season_celebrities(1)

View(season_1)

```


```{r}

get_person_info <- function(url) {

  Sys.sleep(1)

  page <- read_html(url)

  # Get birthday
  birth_node <- page |> html_element(".bday")

  birthday <- if (inherits(birth_node, "xml_missing")) {
    as.Date(NA)
  } else {
    suppressWarnings(as.Date(html_text2(birth_node)))
  }

  # Find birthplace element
  place_node <- page |>
    html_element(".infobox .birthplace, .infobox .birth-place")

  birthplace <- if (inherits(place_node, "xml_missing")) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    html_text2(place_node)
  }

  # Fallback: find birthplace in Born row
  if (is.na(birthplace)) {

    born_rows <- page |>
      html_elements("table.infobox tr") |>
      keep(function(row) {
        header <- row |> html_element("th")

        !inherits(header, "xml_missing") &&
          str_detect(html_text2(header), "^Born$")
      })

    if (length(born_rows) > 0) {

      cell <- born_rows[[1]] |> html_element("td")

      # Extract location links from the Born row
      places <- cell |>
        html_elements("a[href]") |>
        html_text2()

      # Remove empty links
      places <- places[nzchar(places)]

      if (length(places) > 0) {
        birthplace <- paste(places, collapse = ", ")
      }
    }
  }

  tibble(
    from = birthplace,
    birthday = birthday
  )
}

```

```{r}

season_1_full <- season_1 |>
  mutate(
    info = map(wiki_url, function(url) {
      tryCatch(
        get_person_info(url),
        error = function(e) {
          tibble(
            from = NA_character_,
            birthday = as.Date(NA)
          )
        }
      )
    })
  ) |>
  unnest(info) |>
  mutate(
    premiere_date = as.Date("2005-06-01"),

    age = as.integer(
      floor(
        time_length(
          interval(birthday, premiere_date),
          "years"
        )
      )
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    season,
    celebrity,
    from,
    profession,
    age
  )

```


```{r}

season_1_full <- season_1_full |>
  mutate(
    from = case_when(
      celebrity == "Trista Sutter" ~ "St. Louis, Missouri",
      celebrity == "Evander Holyfield" ~ "Atlanta, Georgia",
      TRUE ~ from
    )
  )

View(season_1_full)

```


```{r}

# View all celebrity information
View(season_1_full)

# Check if any information is missing
season_1_full |>
  filter(is.na(from) | is.na(age)

```
